type: source-level ownership audit; not a dynamic test

invariants.obligation: No S2 store disappears at an epoch boundary
invariants.evidence: svbEpochBoundary enters l1CrossPackageBlocked, which already drives LSU nack and MSHR preservationRetry, in addition to inhibiting s2_write_grant.

invariants.obligation: An owned committed S3 write retains its predecessor until physical effect
invariants.evidence: Actual svbFlush is inhibited while s3_valid, unapplied, nonduplicate, uncancelled, not pre-effect killed, and uniquely dependent on the matching SVB lease. No new dependency on dataWriteArb ready/fire.
svbFlushPending retains the boundary until actual flush. Reset priority is retained separately in svbResetPending.

invariants.obligation: No snapshot crosses an epoch boundary
invariants.evidence: Capture eligibility and reader admission are inhibited by boundary; snapshot discard uses boundary, while the previous pending/issued cancellation descriptor still drains late responses.
Held-write dependency uses registered S3 request/state, resident/image metadata and watermark. It does not use the S2 nack/grant, capture.ready, physical write fire, or actual flush.
Existing SPEC flush and failure invalidation remain unchanged. No restore interface, rollback action, or architectural checkpoint is added.

dynamic_acceptance: pending full-system failing workload, BFS and Blackscholes
